title: PDCP-NR: some decryption changes.
description:
- show 'deciphering disabled' context setting in tree
- decrypt DRBs even if don't think have seen securityModeComplete
- try to decrypt even if not in strict SN order

notes.body: requested review from @pquantin
There should be no worry as a rollover is forbidden in the spec: the gNB should perform a handover before reaching the max count value

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2244/diffs?diff_id=150481110&start_sha=61084ca9752e790bd9fc2e8f66508bfac8bfbc88#4afa19b72a57c2cebd79e8d2f5ad30f1b4743958_1038_1032)

Out of order delivery is allowed for NR PDCP, so IMHO there should have no option for this and it should be always allowed (and even when in order delivery isused, the reordering is performed by PDCP and not RLC).

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2244/diffs?diff_id=150481110&start_sha=61084ca9752e790bd9fc2e8f66508bfac8bfbc88#4afa19b72a57c2cebd79e8d2f5ad30f1b4743958_1002_1000)
So this variable is meaningless for NR PDCP

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2244/diffs?diff_id=150481110&start_sha=61084ca9752e790bd9fc2e8f66508bfac8bfbc88#4afa19b72a57c2cebd79e8d2f5ad30f1b4743958_1003_1000)
I removed the pref/flag.

Should we instead display an info only when ciphering is enabled? Here it's gonna polute the tree for the majority of users as I guess not many people use Wireshark to perform deciphering. Just wondering
This field will be there, but hidden unless set to true.

@pquantin - no rush, but does this look ok now?

It looks up the current COUNT etc now even if the SN status is not 'Ok'.
Done, sorry for the delay.

Why do we have the p_pdcp_info->plane == NR_USER_PLANE here? Should not we have `(pdu_security && !p_pdcp_info->ciphering_disabled) ? pdu_security->seen_next_ul_pdu: FALSE`? Maybe I misunderstood the intent.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2244/diffs?diff_id=152161500&start_sha=3f010a75473b130fd14e2719974fb3f94ec92a75#4afa19b72a57c2cebd79e8d2f5ad30f1b4743958_2264_2275)

This is so that DRBs get deciphered even if the SecurityModeComplete (or even any SRB traffic) is not in the capture.
I have reworked this.

As we now try to support out of sequence SNs, it would be better to apply the algorithm from 38.323 chapter 5.2.2.1. The current approach will likely break. The problem is that it requires to track rx_deliv, but the current assumption that we can use the current HFN will not work if you have RLC retransmissions (thus out of order PDCP SN reception) around a HFN increase. Not sure how robust you want this code to be but it will definitely happen for real logs not in perfect radio conditions.
I would like to track and update these vars, but will tackle it in a later change.
